guards.watches: a block type declared in a section's {% schema %} that the section never renders, a section with blocks that never outputs {{ block.shopify_attributes }}, and an "@app" block declared but never rendered. All three pass Theme Check and look fine in review; they show up only when a merchant adds the block in the theme editor and nothing appears, or it cannot be selected.
guards.extend: a new local block type in a section that branches on block.type needs its own `when 'type'` inside `case block.type` (or a `block.type == 'type'` test). If the case's `else` branch renders it on purpose, add it to ELSE_BRANCH_ALLOWED with the reason.
